newsitem.title: CHINA: Fierce competition seen in China mini-car sector.
newsitem.headline: Fierce competition seen in China mini-car sector.

text.p: Fierce competition in China's mini-car market will intensify this year as producers burdened by over-capacity fight for customers, the Economic Information Daily said on Friday.
Total demand for mini-cars would rise only slightly to around 120,000 vehicles in 1997, far below production capacity of over 260,000 among major producers, the newspaper said.
Tianjin Automobile Industrial Co Ltd alone could produce 150,000 Charade compact cars a year and was expected to roll out 100,000 in 1997, it said.
Total production of mini-cars was likely to be over 152,500 vehicles this year, it said.
"From this it can be seen that there is an unavoidable serious imbalance between supply and demand, and this will cause even fiercer market competition," it said.
